proposals.rationale: Soft hypothesis: reducing the 80 °C hold from the documented 12 h to the existing 2 min duration may leave C–H borylation incomplete.
Soft hypothesis: deleting the provisional reactor-to-heater connection may prevent effective application of the specified heated-block reaction condition.
Soft hypothesis: extending the room-temperature catalyst/ligand/base/B2pin2 pre-stir to the existing 12 h duration may alter the active iridium catalyst population before substrate addition.
